name: Zhejiang ZUCH Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Zhejiang ZUCH Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research and development, production, and sale of electronic connectors in China. It offers home appliance connectors, such as quick disconnect terminals and connectors, ring or spade terminals, small pitch connectors, solderless terminals, RAST connectors, pierce connectors, and compressor connectors.
